```ruby
def totals_by_category(items)
  items.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) { |item, totals| totals[item[:category]] += item[:amount] }
end
```

For example, `totals_by_category([{ category: "food", amount: 12 }, { category: "food", amount: 3 }])` should return `{ "food" => 15 }`.

The hash it returns defaults to 0, so looking up a category that isn't in the input gives 0 instead of `nil`.
